title: LLM gateway and engines
description: Golden signals and SLOs of the local LLM platform: gateway traffic, errors, latency (TTFT, TPOT), tokens, and llama.cpp engine saturation.

links.title: Runbooks
links.tooltip: What to do when an alert fires

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Share of chat requests over the selected time range that did not fail on the server side (unreachable backend, broken stream, 5xx). Client errors (4xx) and client cancellations don't count against it. SLO: 99%.

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time to first token for streaming requests over the selected time range, measured at the gateway (includes queueing and prefill). SLO: 2.5 s.

panels.title: TPOT p95
panels.description: 95th percentile time per output token (after the first) over the selected time range. 100 ms = 10 tokens/s per user. SLO: 100 ms.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Chat completion requests handled by the gateway over the selected time range, all outcomes.

panels.title: Output tokens/s
panels.description: Completion tokens per second across all backends right now (from upstream usage, counted when each request finishes).

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Streaming requests being served right now.

panels.title: Queued in engine
panels.description: Requests waiting inside llama.cpp for a free decode slot (requests_deferred). Anything above 0 adds directly to TTFT.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Prometheus alerts currently firing (deploy/prometheus/alerts.yml). Click the panel link for details.

panels.title: Requests by backend and outcome
panels.description: Completed chat requests per second. outcome: ok, cancelled (client went away), upstream_unavailable (backend unreachable), upstream_error (stream broke), upstream_<status> (engine returned an HTTP error).

panels.title: Server-side error ratio
panels.description: Failed / all requests per backend. Dashed lines: 1% (the whole error budget of a 99% SLO) and 5% (LLMGatewayHighErrorRatio fires after 5 minutes above it).

targets.expr:
(
  sum by (backend) (rate(llm_gateway_requests_total{backend=~"$backend", outcome=~"upstream_(error|unavailable|5..)"}[$__rate_interval]))
  or 0 * sum by (backend) (rate(llm_gateway_requests_total{backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))
)
/ sum by (backend) (rate(llm_gateway_requests_total{backend=~"$backend"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: In-flight requests
panels.description: Streams open at the gateway per backend. Flat and non-zero while nothing completes means a hung stream (LLMGatewayRequestsStuck).

panels.title: Latency · streaming requests, measured at the gateway
Time to first token
panels.description: From the gateway receiving the request to relaying the first generated token: queueing + prefill + network. Grows with prompt length and with queued requests. Red line: 2.5 s SLO on p95.

panels.title: Time per output token
panels.description: Average gap between generated tokens of a request (decode speed). Rises when more streams share the GPU. Red line: 100 ms SLO on p95.

panels.title: Decode speed per user
panels.description: Tokens/s a single user sees while their answer streams (1 / TPOT). 'slowest 5%' is 1 / TPOT p95. Red line: 10 tokens/s, the TPOT SLO.

panels.title: Output tokens/s
panels.description: Completion tokens per second per backend, from the usage block engines send at the end of each request (clients must request it with stream_options.include_usage).

panels.title: Prompt tokens/s
panels.description: Prompt tokens per second per backend. Long prompts drive prefill time and TTFT; compare with the engine's prefix cache hits below.

panels.title: Engine
panels.description: Whether Prometheus can scrape the llama.cpp server (started with --metrics).

panels.title: Prefill speed
panels.description: Prompt tokens processed per second of prompt-processing time over the selected range (cached prefix tokens excluded).

panels.title: Decode speed
panels.description: Tokens per second of one sequence (generated tokens / generation time), over the selected range. The engine-side view of 1 / TPOT.

panels.title: Tokens generated
panels.description: Tokens predicted by the engine over the selected range, from all clients (gateway, llm-bench, anything calling the engine directly).

panels.title: Prefix cache hit ratio
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens served from the KV cache instead of being recomputed, over the selected range. High for multi-turn chat; near 0 for unique prompts.

panels.title: Batch size (lifetime)
panels.description: Average number of busy slots per llama_decode() call, i.e. sequences decoded together, since the engine started (llama.cpp only exports this lifetime average: n_busy_slots_per_decode). Above 1 means continuous batching is doing work; the ceiling is --parallel.

panels.title: Generation throughput
panels.description: aggregate: tokens/s produced by all slots together. per sequence: tokens/s of one stream. The gap between them is the batching gain. llama.cpp updates these counters when a request finishes, so the lines move in steps.

panels.title: Prompt processing
panels.description: prompt tokens/s: tokens prefilled per second of wall time. prefill speed: tokens per second of prompt-processing time. from cache: prompt tokens reused from the KV cache (no compute needed).

panels.title: Slots: processing vs queued
panels.description: processing: decode slots busy with a request. deferred: requests waiting for a free slot. Any deferred request is queueing and its TTFT grows (LlamaCppRequestsQueueing fires after 5 minutes).

panels.title: Tokens generated: engine vs via gateway
panels.description: engine: everything llama.cpp generated. via gateway: completion tokens the gateway relayed for its llamacpp backend. A gap means other clients call the engine directly (benchmarks, agents) and compete for its slots.

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: Prometheus scrape status of every target. A red band on gateway or llamacpp is what LLMGatewayDown / LLMEngineScrapeDown alert on.
